rationale: Mathjs upstream removed all .ts files in the TS-split. Of the 215 new functions added between baseline and HEAD, 209 are already implemented in MathTS (functions/src/typed/ or functions/src/wasm/). The 6 below are the genuine port gap.

ports.name: inverseLaplaceTransform
ports.reason: Symbolic CAS function: manipulates AST nodes, calls parse(), uses substitution. AS-incompatible. Append to existing CAS module.

ports.name: nullSpace
ports.reason: Pure numerical: SVD-based null space. AS-feasible (Float64 pointers, fixed dims). Matrix decomp lives in wasm/matrix/.

ports.name: polyfit
ports.reason: Pure numerical: least-squares polynomial fitting via Vandermonde. AS-feasible. New regression.ts module.

ports.name: histogram
ports.reason: Pure numerical: bin counting on Float64 array. AS-feasible. Append to existing basic.ts.

ports.name: linreg
ports.reason: Pure numerical: simple linear regression returning [slope, intercept, r2]. AS-feasible.

ports.name: movingAverage
ports.reason: Pure numerical: rolling window mean. AS-feasible.
